summary: Retest of iter33 CRITICAL #5 (partner_phone on customer GET /api/bookings). Fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: list_bookings now backfills partner_phone from db.users for assigned bookings whose doc lacks it (booking_controller.py lines 1336-1350). Backend suite: 7/7 passed including the previously-failing iter33 test. Frontend: on customer /account?tab=orders, the Call button on an assigned booking triggered a browser navigation to tel:+919000000003 (captured as REQ_FAILED tel:+919000000003 net::ERR_ABORTED, which is the expected headless behavior — proves window.location.href was set to tel:<partner_phone>). booking_controller.py is 2606 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline; a split (dispatch, lifecycle, refunds, admin ops) would help maintainability.
